claims.proposition: Gossamer-Seg achieved a speed advantage over Tumbril-3D.

claims.span: higher analytical compute cost (96.3 vs 81.5 GFLOPs/scan)
claims.proposition: Gossamer-Seg had a higher analytical compute cost than Tumbril-3D: 96.3 versus 81.5 GFLOPs per scan.
Gossamer-Seg had more parameters than Tumbril-3D: 41.7 M versus 38.2 M.

claims.span: originally published latencies (61 ms vs 48 ms)
claims.proposition: The originally published latencies were 61 ms for Gossamer-Seg and 48 ms for Tumbril-3D.

claims.span: are not directly comparable due to differing hardware, precision, batch size, and voxelisation handling
claims.proposition: The originally published latencies for Gossamer-Seg and Tumbril-3D are not directly comparable because hardware, precision, batch size, and voxelisation handling differed.
qualifiers: differing hardware, precision, batch size, and voxelisation handling

claims.span: Gossamer-Seg achieved lower median latency (29.4 ms vs 47.8 ms)
claims.proposition: Under matched conditions on Coldharbour-LiDAR test scans, Gossamer-Seg achieved lower median latency than Tumbril-3D: 29.4 ms versus 47.8 ms.
Under matched conditions on Coldharbour-LiDAR test scans, Gossamer-Seg achieved lower 90th-percentile latency than Tumbril-3D: 33.1 ms versus 52.6 ms.
Under matched conditions on Coldharbour-LiDAR test scans, Gossamer-Seg achieved higher throughput than Tumbril-3D: 34.0 versus 20.9 scans per second.

claims.span: lower peak memory (3.1 vs 4.6 GB) than Tumbril-3D
claims.proposition: Under matched conditions on Coldharbour-LiDAR test scans, Gossamer-Seg had lower peak memory than Tumbril-3D: 3.1 GB versus 4.6 GB.

claims.span: Gossamer-Seg also showed a slightly higher test mIoU (67.9 ± 0.3% vs 67.5 ± 0.5%)
claims.proposition: Gossamer-Seg showed a slightly higher test mIoU than Tumbril-3D: 67.9 ± 0.3% versus 67.5 ± 0.5%.

claims.span: this difference was not statistically significant (paired t-test, n=3 seeds, p=0.18, 95% CI [-0.46, 1.26] percentage points)
claims.proposition: The test-mIoU difference between Gossamer-Seg and Tumbril-3D was not statistically significant in a paired t-test with 3 seeds, p=0.18, and a 95% confidence interval of -0.46 to 1.26 percentage points.
The per-class IoU comparison between Gossamer-Seg and Tumbril-3D produced mixed results.
Gossamer-Seg had higher car IoU than Tumbril-3D: 95.1 versus 94.8.
Gossamer-Seg had higher cyclist IoU than Tumbril-3D: 63.4 versus 61.9.
Gossamer-Seg had higher pole IoU than Tumbril-3D: 62.0 versus 61.2.
Gossamer-Seg had lower pedestrian IoU than Tumbril-3D: 71.8 versus 73.0.
Gossamer-Seg had lower vegetation IoU than Tumbril-3D: 86.7 versus 86.9.
